documents.title: Clarification With Respect To Disclosure Appearing On Portal Of BSE / NSE
Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Meeting Of Executive Committee Of The Board Of Bhagyanagar India Limited Held On 13.08.2026 - Preferential Allotment Of Equity Shares
In-Principle Approval Under Regulation 28(1) Of SEBI ( LODR) Regulations, 2015
Corrigendum To Extra-Ordinary General Meeting ("EGM") Notice, Dated 30.06.2026
Submission Of Voting Results Along With Scrutinizer Report

analysis.summary: Bhagyanagar India Limited reported a turnover of over 700 crores for Q1 FY27, achieving an EBITDA margin of 5.43% and a PAT of 20 crores. Management stated that sales volumes were impacted by trade route disruptions in the first two months, but normalized in June, leading to a projected full-year volume growth of 12% to 15%. The company is undertaking a restructuring to move its copper business to a wholly owned subsidiary called Tieramet Limited and plans a 40 crore capex over the next two years. Additionally, management highlighted strong traction in value-added products, reaching a 63% share this quarter, and aims to maintain full-year EBITDA margins between 5% and 5.5%. Bhagyanagar India Limited reported its Q1FY27 financial performance with revenues at Rs.

guidance.claim: The company expects to maintain full-year EBITDA margins between 5% and 5.5%.
guidance.quote: Going forward in the year, we hope to maintain the EBITDA margin between 5% and 5.5%.

guidance.claim: Export contribution for the year is estimated to be between 12% and 15%.
guidance.quote: 12-15% would be a good estimate for the year.

guidance.claim: Management targets reaching a revenue of 5,000 crores by FY30.
guidance.quote: So, FY30, as you rightly said, is a conservative estimate. We will reach 5,000 crores by FY30.

guidance.claim: Management targets a 25% CAGR for the next 3 to 4 years.
guidance.quote: 25% CAGR is our target for the next 3 to 4 years.

guidance.claim: The company is aiming for 5,000 crores in the year 2030.
guidance.quote: Our top line projection, as in earlier, this thing, has been project... we are aiming for 3,000 crores in the year 2030. That is, in 3 years, we are planning to reach 5,000 crores in the year 2030.

guidance.claim: Management expects volume growth of 20% minimum every year.
guidance.quote: Between 15% to 20% should be our volume growth minimum every year.

guidance.claim: Management is hopeful of maintaining a 5% EBITDA margin throughout the next year.
guidance.quote: We are hopeful of maintaining 5% EBITDA margin throughout the next year, and on an increased top line.

demand_outlook.claim: India is noted as one of the fastest growing copper users, with secondary copper demand expected to double in 5 years.
demand_outlook.quote: As we can see, India is actually one of the fastest growing copper users in the world, with around 2.4 million metric tons projected to be consumed in India by 2030. Out of this, if you look at the secondary copper demand, it is expected to double in the next 5 years, from 0.7 million metric tons to 1.4 million metric tons.

demand_outlook.claim: The recycled copper market is estimated by some reports to grow at a CAGR of about 12-13%.
demand_outlook.quote: The recycled copper market, by some estimates, should be growing in India at a CAGR of about 12-13%.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that all customers are talking about doubling their capacity in the next 3 years.
demand_outlook.quote: All our customers are looking to increase their volumes and everybody is talking about doubling their capacity in the next 3 years.

demand_outlook.claim: India is expected to become the second largest copper-consuming economy.
demand_outlook.quote: India is expected to become the second largest copper-consuming economy.

demand_outlook.claim: World copper consumption is predicted to reach 50 million tonne by 2050.
demand_outlook.quote: The world consumed around 26 million tonne of copper, which is predicted to become 50 million tonne by 2050, so this is almost doubling.

demand_outlook.claim: Growth in copper consumption will be driven by EV and automotive, power and electrification, and renewable energy sectors.
demand_outlook.quote: This growth will mainly be driven by three sectors, EV and automotive. Because, EV requires a lot more copper than regular cars, power and electrification is also a big growth factor, and renewable energy.

capex_expansion.claim: The management proposed a capex of 40 crores over the next two years, FY27 and FY28.
capex_expansion.quote: The management has proposed to do 40 crores of capex in the next 2 years, FY27 and FY28 and we are well on our way to achieve this.

capex_expansion.claim: The company finished adding a capacity of 35,000 metric tons which is now online.
capex_expansion.quote: We have also finished adding our capacity of 35,000 metric tons, which is online now.

capex_expansion.claim: A further capacity expansion to 45,000 tons is projected for the next financial year between April and June.
capex_expansion.quote: So, this has been projected for the next financial year. The exact timelines are still not there, but as of now, our expectation is between April and June of next year; more likely June next year. From 35,000 to 45,000 tons.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is planning to invest around 10 crores into plastic recycling.
capex_expansion.quote: So, right now, we are planning to invest around 10 crores into plastic recycling, where the cable waste comes in, we process them into different grades, we make granules, and with aluminium and other metals, we make ingots, and then we put them back into the supply chain.

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved an EBITDA margin of 5.43% and a PAT margin of 2.87% for the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: We have achieved an EBITDA margin of 5.43%, which is a 10.38% growth over the last quarter and a 63% growth over the first quarter of last year.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA per kg reached 72 rupees during the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: We have also had our highest share of value-added products sold this quarter, which is 63% and our highest EBITDA per kg of 72 rupees.

margins_costs.claim: Refining charges in primary copper have gone negative as available concentrate goes to China.
margins_costs.quote: You know, the refining charges in primary copper have gone negative, because whatever ore and concentrate is available in the world is all going to China.

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved around 5% EBITDA margin in Q3 and Q4.
margins_costs.quote: In Q3 and Q4: e We’ve achieved around 5% EBITDA, and 2.2% and 2.5% of PAT.

margins_costs.claim: The EBITDA per kg for the year is around 43 rupees.
margins_costs.quote: Our EBITDA per kg for the year is around 43 rupees, which is very high compared to our peers, and as you can see, over the four quarters, our EBITDA per kg has been trending upwards.

margins_costs.claim: In quarter four, the company achieved around 62 rupees per kg in EBITDA.
margins_costs.quote: With the quarter four, we achieved around 62 rupees per kg.

orders_capacity.claim: Sales volumes for the quarter stood at 5,278 tons.
orders_capacity.quote: Our sales volumes have dropped, though; they have gone to 5,278 tons, which is a 9.5% decrease from the last quarter and a 6.5% decrease from last year.

orders_capacity.claim: The share of value-added products sold reached 63% in the quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: We have also had our highest share of value-added products sold this quarter, which is 63% and our highest EBITDA per kg of 72 rupees.

orders_capacity.claim: The company exported more than 100 tons of bus bars to North America in the last quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: In the last quarter itself, we have exported more than 100 tons of bus bars to North America and we are also exporting a lot of transformer products all over the world.

orders_capacity.claim: Installed capacity has reached 35,000 metric tonne this year.
orders_capacity.quote: Our capacity has now reached 35,000 metric tonne this year, with the new, 60-acre integrated facility near Hyderabad.

orders_capacity.claim: Copper sales volume went up by 34% to 24,000 metric tonne last year.
orders_capacity.quote: Last year, we did around 18,000 metric tonne of volume of copper sales. Which has gone up by 34% to, 2 24,000 metric tonne.

capital_allocation.claim: The second tranche of fundraising is expected around March after the demerger.
capital_allocation.quote: The second tranche will probably be around March, after the demerger is done, in the standalone copper unit.

capital_allocation.claim: Projected debt in 2030 is estimated to be between 300 and 350 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: So, our projection is showing that between 300 and 350 crores will be our debt in 2030.

capital_allocation.claim: A preferential issue is planned for a total fund raise of Rs. 52.25 Crores from non-promoters.
Increase in total equity was done entirely through retained earnings without dilution.
capital_allocation.quote: And this increase in equity was not done through dilution, this was all done through retained earnings.

risks_headwinds.claim: Trade route disruptions and material shortages in the first two months caused turnover and volumes to drop.
risks_headwinds.quote: In the first two months, because of the disruption of all the trade routes and the shortage of material all over the country, while the turnover came down, we could take advantage of the situation by increasing our margins.

risks_headwinds.claim: A GST input credit reversal case involving 17 crores has been levied due to retrospective cancellation of a supplier's registration.
risks_headwinds.quote: Because of the retrospective cancellation of the registration of the supplier, the case has been put on us.

risks_headwinds.claim: Sourcing of copper scrap from the Gulf has experienced delayed shipments and drying up due to diverted shipping lines.
risks_headwinds.quote: The scrap coming from Gulf, which is of a short duration, short lead time material, has suddenly dried up. And, the material which is coming from the rest of the world, the shipping lines have been diverted because a lot of shipping lines have a transit point in Dubai or somewhere in the Gulf before coming to India. That has got delayed.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to execute 40 crores of capex across FY27 and FY28.
management_commitments.quote: The management has proposed to do 40 crores of capex in the next 2 years, FY27 and FY28 and we are well on our way to achieve this.

management_commitments.claim: A complete digital transformation of the company is planned over the next year.
management_commitments.quote: Over the next year, we are going to do a complete digital transformation of our company, where every process, every department and all reporting will be completely digitalized automatically, and no manual entry would be required.

management_commitments.claim: The value-added product mix is projected to reach 69% over a period of 3 or 4 years.
management_commitments.quote: So, we had projected last year that we will slowly keep increasing from the 62% which we had, and reach 68-69% over a period of 3 or 4 years.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets achieving 5,000 crores in revenue by FY30.
management_commitments.quote: So, see, the copper prices are out of our control. At 15% volume growth, you can do the reverse math based on the copper prices to see when we achieve it. But we are very confident of 5,000 crores by FY30, whatever the copper price.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to reach 5,000 crores in turnover by the year 2030.
management_commitments.quote: That is, in 3 years, we are planning to reach 5,000 crores in the year 2030.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to invest 40 crores over the next 2 years on capacities and new ventures.
management_commitments.quote: And over here, as mentioned, we are planning to invest 40 crores over the next 2 years on capacities and new ventures.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to raise approximately 150 crores in this financial year.
management_commitments.quote: So, we are looking at a fundraise. We are still not, come up with a final proposal, but we are looking at a fundraise of roughly about 150 crores.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
